tools.name: tamigo_list_departments
tools.description: List all departments (shops, restaurants, units) of the company: DepartmentId (a GUID, used by other tools), DepartmentKey (the POS key set in Tamigo), Name, IsDefault and ParentDepartmentId. GET /departments/application/.

tools.name: tamigo_list_employees
tools.description: List all employees of the company (basic): EmployeeId, Name, Email, IsPlanner, PosKey (the employee key used by the attendance tool) and DepartmentRoles. For contract, wage and absence-balance details use tamigo_list_employee_details. GET /employees/.

tools.name: tamigo_list_employee_details
tools.description: Detailed employee records, 500 per page in alphabetical order: contact data, roles per department, home department, contract hours, wage type and history, absence balances, competencies, custom columns, notes and availability. Bank details and ID numbers are never returned. Large pages are returned

tools.name: tamigo_list_shifts
tools.description: Per employee and day, the original rota, the planned (current) rota and the worked (timesheet) hours for a date range, with department, employee POS key, email and wage number. Use it for payroll checks, hours worked vs planned and who worked when. Shift values are hours. GET /shifts/all/{start}/{en

tools.name: tamigo_list_absences
tools.description: All absences (holiday, sickness, leave) that overlap a date range: employee, department, absence type, start and end, and whether it is approved or rejected. GET /LeaveRequests/All/.

tools.name: tamigo_get_opening_hours
tools.description: Normal and special opening hours per department for a date range. GET /OpeningHours/{start}/{end}/.

tools.name: tamigo_register_attendance
tools.description: WRITE: register check-in and check-out times in the Tamigo timesheet, for one or many employees (the same call a POS system makes). Each entry names a department key and an employee key (the POS keys set in Tamigo under Configuration -> Departments / POS Keys; they are shown by tamigo_list_departmen

tools.name: tamigo_upload_daily_revenue
tools.description: WRITE: import daily revenue per department into Tamigo (the same call a cash-register system makes), used for revenue-based planning and KPIs. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tamigo_list_employees, tamigo_list_shifts · Private data: tamigo_list_employee_details · Public sink: tamigo_list_employees, tamigo_list_shifts, tamigo_upload_daily_revenue.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tamigo_list_employees, tamigo_list_shifts · Private data: tamigo_list_employee_details · Public sink: tamigo_list_employees, tamigo_list_shifts, tamigo_upload_daily_revenue

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
